name: Etched Note
summary: The Etched Note is a formal summons directed to promising young tauren hunters in Camp Narache. Delivered on behalf of the trainer Lanka Farshot, the message calls the novice forward to begin mastering the practical and spiritual arts of the wild.

sections.title: A Summons to the Hunt
sections.body: While training amidst the bluffs of Red Cloud Mesa, young tauren showing an aptitude for marksmanship and tracking are passed an etched message. Handed down through Grull Hawkwind, the note carries word that Lanka Farshot has taken notice of the youth's bloodline and raw capability, urging them to formalize their study beneath his watchful eye.

sections.title: Tradition of the Plains
sections.body: To the Shu'halo, a hunter is far more than a simple scout or warrior. Hunters sustain the tribes through their quarry, protect nomadic encampments, and live in close balance with the beasts of Kalimdor. By calling the novice into training, Lanka sets the groundwork for mastering weapons, understanding the creatures of Mulgore, and eventually undertaking the ancient art of taming wild companions.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Etched Note?
aliases: why did i get etched note
faq.answer: The Etched Note serves as a formal introduction connecting a novice tauren hunter with Lanka Farshot, the local class trainer stationed in Camp Narache.
Grull Hawkwind passes the note along, explaining that a messenger from the hunter trainer sought out the young hunter moments prior.
Lanka Farshot resides within Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa, standing near the hunter training grounds ready to instruct new recruits.

faq.q: Why are hunters so revered among the tauren?
faq.answer: Hunters play a crucial role in tauren society by providing food, reading the untamed wilderness, and maintaining harmony with the spirits of the plains.

faq.q: What skills does this training introduce?
faq.answer: Lanka prepares the novice in foundational hunting techniques, including the use of ranged weaponry, understanding wild beasts, and ultimately the rituals required to tame animal companions.

faq.q: What is the next step after reading the note?
faq.answer: Reporting to Lanka Farshot completes the summons and makes him your trainer, who will teach you to fire your rifle, tame a pet and more as you grow.

angles.text: This summons marks your formal induction into the hunter tradition, preparing you to master marksman arts, wilderness survival, and beast companionship.
For the Shu'halo, hunting is a sacred duty honoring the Earth Mother through respect for the beasts that sustain the tribe across the plains of Mulgore.
